mapper.sql: routePhotoId, routeStepId, photoUrl, storageKey, title, description, lat, lng, photoOrder, regDt, updDt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ROUTE_PHOTOS WHERE routeStepId = #{routeStepId} ORDER BY photoOrder, routePhotoId

SELECT p.routePhotoId, p.routeStepId, p.photoUrl, p.storageKey, p.title, p.description, p.lat, p.lng, p.photoOrder, p.regDt, p.updDt FROM ROUTE_PHOTOS p INNER JOIN ROUTE_STEPS s ON s.routeStepId = p.routeStepId WHERE s.routeId = #{routeId} ORDER BY s.stepOrder, p.photoOrder, p.routePhotoId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROUTE_PHOTOS ( routeStepId, photoUrl, storageKey, title, description, lat, lng, photoOrder ) VALUES ( #{routeStepId}, #{photoUrl}, #{storageKey}, #{title}, #{description}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{photoOrder} )
